blocks.text:
diff --git a/backend/src/interfaces/api/v1/demo_high_risk.py b/backend/src/interfaces/api/v1/demo_high_risk.py
index 59cd8d1..b3d3b46 100644
--- a/backend/src/interfaces/api/v1/demo_high_risk.py
+++ b/backend/src/interfaces/api/v1/demo_high_risk.py
@@ -18,8 +18,9 @@ Rules for this demo:
 from __future__ import annotations
 
 import os
+from pathlib import Path
 
-from fastapi import APIRouter
+from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
 from fastapi.responses import FileResponse
 
 router = APIRouter(tags=["SecurityDemo"])
@@ -37,6 +38,13 @@ DEMO_FILES_DIR = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "demo_files_base")
     ),
 )
 async def demo_download(name: str) -> FileResponse:
-    # VULNERABLE (intentional): no containment check on the resolved path.
-    file_path = os.path.join(DEMO_FILES_DIR, name)
-    return FileResponse(file_path, filename=name)
+    # FIX (CWE-22 path traversal): normalize the resolved path and enforce
+    # containment within DEMO_FILES_DIR. Reject any traversal that escapes
+    # the base directory (and any name that does not resolve to a real file).
+    base = Path(DEMO_FILES_DIR).resolve()
+    target = (base / name).resolve()
+    if not target.is_relative_to(base):
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Not found")
+    if not target.is_file():
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Not found")
+    return FileResponse(target, filename=target.name)
